subject.title: fix(codex): surface native subagent task updates

question: Should Codex native subagent mirror tasks become visible for every embedded run with a normalized requester delivery route, including direct cron-style routes, or should visibility also inherit a parent notify-policy or silent-flow gate?
rationale: The code path is mechanically coherent, but the linked issue discussion already identified quiet-flow behavior as the product boundary that automation cannot decide safely.

options.title: Accept route-backed visibility
options.body: Treat a normalized requester route as sufficient intent for native subagent state-change updates while keeping no-route runs silent.

options.title: Require parent visibility gating
options.body: Change the PR so native mirror visibility also depends on the parent run's notify policy or an equivalent explicit visible-mode signal.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Keep the issue open while owners decide the permanent Codex-native subagent task visibility contract.

recommendation.title: Accept route-backed visibility
recommendation.body: Treat a normalized requester route as sufficient intent for native subagent state-change updates while keeping no-route runs silent.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the Codex native mirror behavior introduced in PR #79512.
